movies.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

tv_shows.overview: It can be a badge of honor to be “single.” “I Live Alone” is a documentary-style South Korean reality series that follows the members of a self-formed club called Rainbow, which is comprised of  celebrities who are single and live alone.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: 4.53 million households in Korea! Single-person households are the trend now! A third of the entertainment industry is also single-person households! Stars who have become single for different reasons, including wild goose fathers, weekend couples, young people struggling after coming to Seoul, and single men & women!  What is the single life of a confident single-person household? At a time when single-person households have become a trend, we try to form a social consensus through the program. Filming their daily lives with documentary techniques. Honest appearance of single life, know-how of wise life. It leads to a candid story about the philosophy of living alone.
